# Originary

Originary develops software for issuing, verifying, and packaging signed
records of machine actions across organizational boundaries.

Originary Verify helps teams create signed records when APIs, agents, MCP
tools, gateways, payment flows, and provisioning systems act, so another
party can verify what the issuer recorded without private-log or dashboard access.

Current protocol release: PEAC v0.16.3 "Gateway Decision Evidence", which adds
a gateway decision evidence profile over the existing access-decision record,
a runnable offline-verifiable example, and an integrator guide. The wire format
is unchanged. Earlier evidence patterns remain available: paid resources, paid
MCP tool records, linked counterparty acknowledgments, Merkle commitment
helpers, external evidence anchoring, agent spend attribution, agent run
lineage records, consented action records, and runtime lineage exports.

Last updated: 2026-07-22

Organization: Originary (legal entity: Poem, Inc.)
Location: Delaware, USA
Contact: contact@originary.xyz

## What it is

Portable verification for API, MCP, agent, gateway, payment, and
provisioning workflows. Originary Verify creates signed records so another
party can verify what the issuer recorded without internal logs, dashboard access, or
vendor runtime.

## Product pages

- https://www.originary.xyz/how-it-works - how signed records are issued at six surfaces (API, MCP, agent, gateway, payment, provisioning) and verified offline
- https://www.originary.xyz/records - gallery of signed record types (API, MCP, agent, gateway, payment, provisioning), each verifiable offline
- https://www.originary.xyz/verify - verify a signed record with the issuer's public key; offline by design, nothing stored
- https://www.originary.xyz/mcp - signed records for MCP tool calls, inputs, and result digests
- https://www.originary.xyz/ai-gateway - signed records for AI gateway decisions: allow, deny, redaction digests, and observed spend
- https://www.originary.xyz/provisioning-records - signed records for deployments, provider setup, credentials, budgets, and resource lifecycle events
- https://www.originary.xyz/agentic-commerce - signed records that preserve what a paid agent action reported

## Open protocol

PEAC Protocol is an Apache-2.0 open-source project for portable signed
interaction records, maintained by Originary.

- https://github.com/peacprotocol/peac

## Notes

Originary does not replace gateways, observability, payment rails, policy
engines, or runtimes. It records selected facts so another party can later
verify what the issuer recorded.
